name: Rosewood Villa Magna
insider_take: Nestled on the prestigious Paseo de la Castellana, Rosewood Villa Magna is Madrid's crown jewel of luxury — a sophisticated urban retreat where old-world Spanish elegance meets contemporary Rosewood refinement.
whats_special: Originally opened in 1972 and reborn under the iconic Rosewood brand, Villa Magna occupies one of Madrid's most coveted addresses. The hotel's stunning redesign celebrates Spanish artisanship through curated local art, hand-selected materials, and interiors that pay homage to Madrid's rich cultural heritage. Its flagship restaurant, Flor de Caña , captivates guests with modern Spanish haute cuisine, while its position steps from the Golden Mile of luxury shopping on Serrano Street makes it a magnet for discerning travelers.
pro_tip: Request a room overlooking the Paseo de la Castellana for sweeping boulevard views, especially magical at dusk when Madrid's famous golden light bathes the city skyline.
dont_miss: A visit to the nearby Museo del Prado is just minutes away — pair it with an afternoon stroll through the elegant Retiro Park , Madrid's beloved green oasis. Back at the hotel, indulge in a signature treatment at the Sense, A Rosewood Spa — one of the most exclusive wellness experiences in the Spanish capital.
pros: Prime location on prestigious Paseo de la Castellana
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Elegant rooms and suites with sophisticated Spanish design
Award-winning dining experiences and rooftop terrace
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Limited recreational facilities compared to resort properties
